scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @neon-strike/shared" "npm run dev -w @neon-strike/server" "npm run dev -w @neon-strike/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @neon-strike/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @neon-strike/server
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @neon-strike/server
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build -w @neon-strike/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test:build: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.build.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && node --test server/test/*.test.mjs shared/test/*.test.mjs
